parsed.notes:
The optional section begins at “The following isn’t required, but we’d love to see it:”.
Image/video data applications and unstructured data processing are read literally, without inferring computer vision, NLP, or knowledge graphs. The agentic-systems ask is an alternative to image/video applications, but those alternatives have no exact taxonomy entries, leaving no group with two mapped members.
Software development life cycle and tools is retained as an unmapped specific practice rather than silently broadened to software engineering; the explicit optional software-development ask supplies the software-engineering criterion.
ETL pipelines and data pipelines collapse into one skill, grouped with workflow automation. The systems-language examples form a separate alternative group.
The optional “advanced degree” names no specific higher degree level; bachelor is the highest explicitly named level and is required.
The 2+ years minimum is interpreted as the guide’s approximately two-year junior signal; no stated seniority is present.
